thesis: The Atlas ML model continues to favor mining stocks, particularly those involved in diversified metals and precious metals. The top picks include Hercules Metals (BIG.V), AbraSilver Resource (ABRA.TO), and Targa Exploration Corp. (TEX.CN), all of which have high ML scores and predicted returns. These selections align with the model's focus on diversified metals and precious metals, which are expected to perform well over the medium term.
